from_the_caption: GPI-RUSH reached the Golgi by 2h in both DAB-positive and DAB-negative cells (arrows).
In DAB-positive cells, GPI-RUSH was retained in newly forming Golgi at 6h (arrows) and reached the plasma membrane (PM) mainly by 10h (arrowheads).
At 2h, GPI-RUSH localized to newly forming Golgi vacuolar membranes (B, white arrows) with no PM signal (B, arrowheads).
At 2h, GPI-RUSH localized to newly forming Golgi vacuolar membranes (B, white arrows) with no PM signal (B, arrowheads).
No GPI-RUSH was detected in the old Golgi (B, C; black arrows).
At 10h, GPI-RUSH was detected at the plasma membrane (C, arrowheads) and in the newly formed Golgi stacks (C, white arrow; D corresponds to dashed box).
At 10h, GPI-RUSH was detected at the plasma membrane (C, arrowheads) and in the newly formed Golgi stacks (C, white arrow; D corresponds to dashed box).
No GPI-RUSH was detected in the old Golgi (B, C; black arrows).
In DAB-treated cells, post-Golgi delivery was mainly observed by 10h after inactivation (E; arrowheads).
In control cells, M6PR-RUSH was efficiently delivered to post-Golgi compartments by 6h (F; arrowheads).
